Traffic Jam in Rohtas Disrupts Ambulance Services

A traffic jam lasting over two hours occurred in Kargahar, Rohtas, causing significant distress to patients as ambulances were caught in the congestion. The obstruction was reportedly caused by the occupation of Station Chowk by Toto-auto vehicles, leading to daily traffic snarls. Commuters expressed frustration over the prolonged travel times.
